import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import zscore


def task_func(data_matrix):
    import numpy as np
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    df = pd.DataFrame(data_matrix)
    if df.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("data_matrix must be a 2D data structure.")

    values = df.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    z_values = zscore(values, axis=1, nan_policy="omit")

    z_df = pd.DataFrame(
        z_values,
        columns=[f"Feature {i + 1}" for i in range(values.shape[1])],
    )
    z_df["Mean"] = z_df.mean(axis=1, skipna=True)

    corr_matrix = z_df.iloc[:, :-1].corr()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
    sns.heatmap(
        corr_matrix,
        ax=ax,
        cmap="coolwarm",
        vmin=-1,
        vmax=1,
        center=0,
        annot=False,
        square=True,
        cbar=True,
    )
    ax.set_title("Correlation Matrix of Z-scores")
    ax.set_xlabel("Features")
    ax.set_ylabel("Features")
    fig.tight_layout()

    return z_df, ax
